race.description: Tld Team Gough Putts For Dad
race.comment: MINI EASY (3) has mixed form recently, finishing sixth (25.95) in a Grade 5 at Ballarat latest but did run well two back when in the frame. Meets a moderate line up and rates on top this time. HIGHLAND SAL (1) found the frame for the second consecutive time when narrowly beaten into second last time out (16.91) over 300m at this track. Can turn it around this time. HAPPY CHICK (2) has mixed form recently, finishing fourth (17.13) in a Grade 5 at this track latest but did run well two back when in the frame. Rates a winning chance on best. BRUREE PAT (7) is a last-start placegetter at this track and distance - should be thereabouts.
